paper_type: Data Descriptor: dataset release with QC, PCA and mean-expression figures; no DE results reported
assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, single-end 75 bp, NextSeq 500; STAR -> HTSeq raw counts, 24,613 genes (S2.4.p1, S2.5.p1)
organism: Rattus norvegicus (female Sprague Dawley, 8-9 weeks at injury) (S1.p3, S2.1.p1)
sample_inclusion: 37 liver samples in two independent sample sets (S2.2.p1, TAB1): SCI + In-Cage Activity: No SCI + Standard cage (5), CONT SCI + Tiny cage (5), CONT SCI + Large cage (5); SCI + Exercise (all tiny cages): No SCI (4), TX SCI (4), CONT SCI (4), CONT SCI + SWIM (5), CONT SCI + SWW (5)
sample_exclusion: none stated; S4.3.p1-p3 only remark that overlapping samples could be removed, without doing so
primary_estimand: how chronic-SCI liver transcriptome is modified by spontaneous in-cage activity and by exercise (S1.p2, S1.p3): within contusion-injured rats, large vs tiny cage (In-Cage Activity set) and SWIM or SWW vs no exercise, all in tiny cages (Exercise set)
planned_contrasts: In-Cage Activity set: CONT + Large cage vs CONT + Tiny cage (S1.p3, S4.3.p1, FIG5b) - DEG count not reported
Exercise set: CONT + SWIM vs CONT (tiny) (S1.p3, S4.3.p2, FIG5c) - DEG count not reported
Exercise set: CONT + SWW vs CONT (tiny) (S1.p3, S4.3.p2, FIG5c) - DEG count not reported
context_contrasts_non_exercise: TX vs CONT vs No SCI (FIG5d, S4.3.p3)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one liver per rat; rats doubly housed with the same group (S2.2.p1)

blocking_or_covariance.note: the two sample sets were run separately (different read depths, TAB1); time post-injury differs by condition (S2.3.p1, S4.4.p1)

normalization: DESeq2 RLE size factors (S2.5.p3, S8.p9); DESeq2 rlog for PCA (S2.5.p2)
paper_method: no DE test reported; DESeq2 used for normalization only (S2.5.p3)

paper_threshold.note: Data Descriptor (Scientific Data): no differential-expression test, no DEG list, no threshold in the article
